notes: s021 could be headed on 'vexed' if the frame were read as glossing the verb rather than the noun root; δαιμονίζομαι is denominal and 'demon' is what answers to the daimon- root, so rule 66's denominal clause keeps the head there.
Both supplied address words ('O' before Lord, 'thou' before son) stand on anarthrous vocatives, so they are rule 7 helpers on the nouns under rule 89's anarthrous clause.
The article before ὁρίων is emptied by the attributive demonstrative under rule 38, not by rule 23.
